elements.name: big crowded bus station yard in Addis Ababa
shorter young man with backpack seen from behind in centre
taller young man in blue denim jacket with nothing on his back
two young men standing close together
five men in a half circle leaning in and gesturing with open hands
men painted as dark faceless silhouettes against bright yard lamps

wrong_setting: Daytime city street with moving city buses and Western-style multi-storey buildings instead of a night bus station yard in Addis Ababa; the frame is a photorealistic render with a paper-stain overlay rather than gouache.
anatomy: Hands are slightly malformed, with the right hand's fingers fused and stubby; the background figures are smeared.
notes: Regenerate as a night gouache bus-station yard with both young men from behind (the second in a denim jacket) and five faceless silhouettes in a half circle under lamps; restore the reference outfit (grey jacket, olive rolled trousers, blue sandals) and blank the garbled destination signs on the buses.
